features.description: New keybindingFlavor settings key (classic|readline) changes prompt editing-key semantics; operator-scope settings references should list it.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added a `keybindingFlavor` setting: set it to "readline" to make Ctrl+W in the prompt delete back to the previous whitespace, as in Bash; the default ("classic") is unchanged

features.description: headersHelper mints short-lived HTTP headers for url marketplaces and catalog/archive entries, with install-time confirmation and credential-env scrubbing for project-scope declarations; marketplace and MCP template docs should cover the trust and scrubbing rules.
features.reference_changelog_line: Plugin marketplaces: `headersHelper` on a url marketplace or a catalog entry runs a command that mints HTTP headers (e.g. a short-lived token) for catalog and same-origin archive fetches

features.description: MCP headersHelper in a project .mcp.json, and inline MCP servers in project or --add-dir agent files, now require the folder trust dialog and run without inherited credential env vars; affects the shipped mcp-enabled.json template guidance.
features.reference_changelog_line: MCP `headersHelper` in a project `.mcp.json`, and inline MCP servers in project or `--add-dir` agent files, now require that folder's trust dialog

features.description: claude mcp list/get now show disabled servers without connecting for a health check; doctor's MCP connectivity check must not read a Disabled row as a probe result.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `claude mcp list` and `claude mcp get` to show disabled servers as Disabled instead of connecting to them for a health check

features.description: self-hosted-runner gains --defer-shutdown-max-min and proxy-authorization command/file flags; relevant to the shared 4-box runner pool operations documentation.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `claude self-hosted-runner --defer-shutdown-max-min <minutes>`

features.description: Subagent forking defaults on; fork inherits conversation/cache and non-teammate spawns run in background.
features.reference_changelog_line: Subagent forking is now on by default: a `subagent_type: "fork"` subagent inherits the full conversation and prompt cache, and non-teammate agent spawns in interactive sessions now run in the background by default

features.description: SendMessage now delivers straight to a bare name matching one live session instead of requiring a ref.
features.reference_changelog_line: `SendMessage` now delivers to a bare name that exactly matches one live session, instead of asking to confirm with a ref first

features.description: Session names are now forced unique per machine, with a name-word-word variant assigned on collision.
features.reference_changelog_line: Interactive sessions on one machine now keep unique names: starting or renaming a session to a name another live session already uses gives it a `name-word-word` variant and tells you

features.description: A url-typed blockedMarketplaces entry now still blocks when the CLI classifies the URL as a git clone.
features.reference_changelog_line: Enterprise policy: a url-typed `blockedMarketplaces` entry for a bare repo URL keeps blocking that URL when the CLI classifies it as a git clone

features.description: Gateway desktop: overlay accepts all Desktop settings, validated at boot; unknown or invalid keys fail boot.
features.reference_changelog_line: Gateway: the `desktop:` overlay now accepts every released Desktop setting (was 11 hand-listed keys), validated at boot against Desktop's own schema; unknown or invalid keys fail boot

features.description: Empty policy match groups and malformed email_domain values now fail gateway boot instead of silently matching.
features.reference_changelog_line: Gateway: empty `managed.policies[].match.groups`/`admin.admin_groups` entries and malformed `email_domain` values (empty, or containing `@`, whitespace, or commas) now fail at boot instead of silently matching no one or granting admin access

features.description: Fixed PowerShell permission bypass via variable-writing params overwriting $PSDefaultParameterValues.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a PowerShell permission bypass where variable-writing parameters could silently overwrite `$PSDefaultParameterValues` and redirect later commands' file access

features.description: Nested git repositories no longer inherit parent trust; each repo requires its own trust confirmation.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed nested git repositories inheriting trust from a parent directory; each repository now requires its own trust confirmation

features.description: Fixed bridge-hosted Remote Control sessions inheriting a cloud session's transcript or credentials.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Remote Control sessions hosted by a bridge inside a cloud session inheriting that session's transcript or credentials

features.description: /plugin install plugin@marketplace now refreshes the marketplace first so new plugins install directly.
features.reference_changelog_line: `/plugin install plugin@marketplace` now refreshes the marketplace first, so newly published plugins install without a manual marketplace update

features.description: /code-review at high, xhigh, and max effort now runs in a background agent like the other levels.
features.reference_changelog_line: `/code-review` at high, xhigh, and max effort now runs in a background agent like the other levels

features.description: Bash input redirections (< file) are now permission-checked like argument spellings on all platforms.
features.reference_changelog_line: Bash input redirections (`< file`) are now permission-checked like their argument spellings on all platforms

features.description: Cowork sessions no longer inline external @-imports from user-scope memory files.
features.reference_changelog_line: Cowork sessions no longer inline external @-imports from user-scope memory files

features.description: Cross-session messaging socket dir on /tmp now refuses pre-planted symlinks or other users' directories.
features.reference_changelog_line: Hardened the auto-generated cross-session messaging socket directory on shared `/tmp`: a pre-planted symlink or another user's directory is now refused instead of used

features.description: Hardened the Linux filesystem sandbox against a protected-path bypass.
features.reference_changelog_line: Hardened the Linux filesystem sandbox against a protected-path bypass

features.description: sandbox.ripgrep is honored only from user, managed, and --settings; project settings can no longer override it.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `sandbox.ripgrep` to be honored only from user, managed, and `--settings` settings; project settings can no longer override the sandbox's ripgrep binary

features.description: Typing @ in the prompt mentions another Claude session by name, routing through SendMessage.
features.reference_changelog_line: Type `@` in the prompt to mention another Claude session by name; Claude then uses `SendMessage` to reach that session directly

features.description: Adds GitLab token-family redaction and gives the glab CLI config store gh-level sandbox and credential protection.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added secret redaction for GitLab token families (`glrt-`, `gloas-`, `glptt-`, `glagent-`, `glimt-`, `glsoat-`, `glcbt-`, `glft-`, `glffct-`) and full redaction of routable `glpat-`/`gldt-` tokens; the `glab` CLI config store gets the same sandbox and credential-path protection as `gh`

features.description: Managed settings dialog now requires approval for server-managed sandbox binary overrides.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved the managed settings approval dialog: shows endpoint URLs, uses clearer wording for telemetry-only changes, skips routine OpenTelemetry options, and requires approval for server-managed sandbox binary overrides (`sandbox.bwrapPath`, `sandbox.socatPath`, `sandbox.ripgrep`)

features.description: New /config rows for Dialog expiry and cross-session inbound message accept/hold/refuse.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `/config` rows for "Dialog expiry" and "Messages from your other sessions" (cross-session inbound accept/hold/refuse)

features.description: Skill/command argument values are no longer re-expanded as template markers, closing a template-injection vector.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed skill/command argument substitution to prevent argument values from being re-expanded as template markers

features.description: TaskCreate/Get/Update/List and TodoWrite are gone on Opus 4.8/Sonnet 5/Fable 5/Mythos 5 unless an env var re-enables the
features.reference_changelog_line: Todo/task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) are no longer available on Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5, and newer models; set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` to bring them back

features.description: The 2.1.232 Bash permission changes for input redirections and Cygwin symlinks were reverted pending a narrower version.
features.reference_changelog_line: Reverted the 2.1.232 Bash permission changes for Cygwin-style symlinks on Windows and for input redirections (`< file`); a narrower version will return in a later release

features.description: The `--worktree` flag and `claude agents` view now accept GitLab merge request URLs, showing MRs as `!N`.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added GitLab merge request URL support to the `--worktree` flag and the `claude agents` view (where MRs display as `!N`)

features.description: `claude plugin validate` now checks a bare `.claude/skills` directory and reports unparseable SKILL.md frontmatter.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved `claude plugin validate` to check a bare `.claude/skills` directory, reporting SKILL.md files whose frontmatter fails to parse

features.description: Opt-in `forward_user_identity` apps gateway setting sends signed-in user identity headers for per-user spend attribution
features.reference_changelog_line: Added an opt-in `forward_user_identity` apps gateway setting on Anthropic upstreams that sends the signed-in user's identity as headers, so a proxy behind the gateway can attribute spend per user

features.description: `CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT` enables opt-in memory cgroups for Bash tool commands on Linux.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added opt-in memory cgroup support for Bash tool commands on Linux (`CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT`) so a runaway build can't stall the session

features.description: `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS` configures the WebFetch session URL cache TTL, default still 15 minutes.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS` environment variable to configure the WebFetch session URL cache TTL (default unchanged: 15 minutes)

features.description: Print mode writes a `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]` stderr line for unknown model IDs, silenced via `modelOverrides`.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved print mode diagnostics: a `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]` line is written to stderr when a request goes out for a model ID Claude Code doesn't recognize; map it with `modelOverrides` to silence

features.description: Pre-approval file accesses now reject Windows NT-namespace paths, closing an NTLM credential-leak vector.
features.reference_changelog_line: Security: remote file reads, session restore, CLAUDE.md includes, workflow scripts and file uploads now reject Windows NT-namespace (`\??\`) paths, hardening the remaining pre-approval file accesses against the NTLM credential-leak vector

features.description: Session-scoped permission answers, including denies, now persist when answered from background subagent prompts.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed session-scoped permission answers (including denies) being dropped when answering background subagent tool permission prompts

features.description: MCP diagnostics no longer print resolved secrets; warnings show ${VAR} form and only the server origin.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed MCP diagnostics printing resolved secrets: scope-conflict warnings now show the configured `${VAR}` form, and connection-failure details show only the server origin

features.description: strictKnownMarketplaces no longer accepts SCP-style git sources whose host differs from git's actual target.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `strictKnownMarketplaces` allowlists accepting SCP-style git marketplace sources whose host differs from the one git would actually connect to

features.description: Accepting the fullscreen renderer prompt no longer restarts the session without its permission mode and tool rules.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed accepting the "Try the new fullscreen renderer?" prompt restarting the session without its permission mode (e.g. `--dangerously-skip-permissions`), tool allow/deny rules, model or effort flags

features.description: /tui now declines to restart instead of dropping launch --allowed-tools/--disallowed-tools restrictions.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed `/tui` dropping launch `--allowed-tools`/`--disallowed-tools` rules when it restarts; it now declines to switch, with the reason, when the session has restrictions a restart can't carry over

features.description: Trust prompts now show the repository-wide scope warning for directories first seen before the repo existed.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed trust prompts omitting the repository-wide scope warning when the directory was first seen before the repository existed there

features.description: Permission previews relay only to channel servers admitted by the inbound trust gate, honoring capability opt-out.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed: permission previews now relay only to channel servers admitted by the inbound trust gate, and a server's explicit permission-capability opt-out is honored

features.description: Credential masking can no longer hide commands, paths, or destinations from the approver on relayed previews.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed: credential masking on relayed permission previews can no longer hide commands, paths, or destinations from the approver; oversized private-key blocks now redact under full-strength redaction

features.description: Provider API tokens on permission previews now mask even when directly followed by shell delimiters.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed: provider API tokens that mask on permission previews now mask even when directly followed by shell delimiters

features.description: /goal now clears itself with a notice when a turn dies on an unrecoverable error instead of staying armed.
features.reference_changelog_line: `/goal` now clears itself with a notice when a turn dies on an unrecoverable error (e.g. revoked auth, an exhausted credit balance, or a context overflow) instead of staying armed

features.description: claude setup-token now rejects unexpected extra arguments instead of silently ignoring them.
features.reference_changelog_line: `claude setup-token` now rejects unexpected extra arguments instead of silently ignoring them

features.description: Default teammate model setting removed; agent-team teammates inherit the leader's model unless the spawn names one.
features.reference_changelog_line: Removed the "Default teammate model" setting from `/config`; agent-team teammates now use the leader's model unless the spawn names one

features.description: Between-turn background task notifications are now delivered to the model inside <system-reminder> tags.
features.reference_changelog_line: Background task notifications delivered between turns are now sent to the model inside `<system-reminder>` tags, matching mid-turn delivery

features.description: /add-dir and several config dialogs can now be opened while Claude is working in the fullscreen TUI.
features.reference_changelog_line: `/add-dir <path>` can now be used while Claude is working; `/add-dir`, `/autocompact`, `/theme`, `/help`, `/config` and `/advisor` dialogs open mid-turn in the fullscreen TUI

features.description: /permissions can be opened mid-turn and rule changes apply to the remainder of the current turn.
features.reference_changelog_line: `/permissions` can now be opened while Claude is working — rule changes apply to the rest of the current turn

features.description: New CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME env var sets a short name for the per-project transcript directory.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added the optional `CLAUDE_CODE_PROJECT_DIR_NAME` environment variable: hosts that give each session its own config directory can choose a short name for the per-project transcript directory

features.description: New selection:clear keybinding action clears an in-app text selection, also working in the agents view.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added the `selection:clear` keybinding action, so a key can be bound to clear an in-app text selection; also works in the agents view

features.description: SendMessage and ListAgents now report when the account session list was too long to check completely.
features.reference_changelog_line: `SendMessage` and `ListAgents` now say when your account's session list was too long to check completely, instead of treating unseen sessions as absent

features.description: CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES controls goal check-ins on background tasks waiting 30+ minutes; 0 opts out.
features.reference_changelog_line: `/goal`: when background tasks keep a goal waiting for 30+ minutes, Claude now checks in on them instead of waiting indefinitely (set `CLAUDE_CODE_GOAL_CHECKIN_MINUTES=0` to opt out)

features.description: Shift+Tab in the permission prompt comment field no longer approves the edit and grants session-wide edit permission.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed Shift+Tab inside the permission prompt's comment field approving the edit and granting session-wide edit permission instead of closing the field

features.description: Permission dialog text now matches the actual grant scope; "don't ask again" is withheld when contents aren't fully show
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved permission dialogs: display text and "don't ask again" options now always match what a grant would cover, and "don't ask again" is withheld when contents cannot be fully displayed

features.description: SendMessage now rejects oversized cross-session messages up front instead of silently dropping them.
features.reference_changelog_line: `SendMessage` now refuses messages too large for cross-session delivery up front instead of silently dropping them

features.description: The `claude rc` CLI command now enforces the same enterprise-gateway availability check as interactive startup.
features.reference_changelog_line: Remote Control: `claude rc` now applies the same enterprise-gateway availability check as interactive startup

features.description: New optional `spellcheck` setting underlines misspelled prompt words using installed aspell, hunspell, or ispell.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added an optional `spellcheck` setting that underlines misspelled words in the prompt input as you type, using your installed `aspell`, `hunspell`, or `ispell`

features.description: Managed-settings approval prompt no longer swallows the first keypress as an implicit approval at startup.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed the managed-settings approval prompt sometimes not appearing at startup while still capturing the first keypress as approval

features.description: Auto mode suspends Monitor allow rules, so Monitor commands get the same review path as Bash commands.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved auto mode: `Monitor` allow rules are now set aside while auto mode is active, so Monitor commands are reviewed the same way Bash commands are

features.description: Auto-mode classifier now uses Claude API defaults, including severity scoring, on Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved auto mode on Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Foundry, and when telemetry is disabled: the classifier now uses the same defaults as on the Claude API, including severity-scored classification

features.description: Auto mode's git status check can no longer be spoofed clean by status.showUntrackedFiles=no.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved auto mode: the git status check can no longer be fooled by a repo's `status.showUntrackedFiles=no` setting into reporting a clean tree

features.description: /goal sessions parked behind background work now self-check-in at 30m, then 1h and 2h, without user input.
features.reference_changelog_line: `/goal`: an idle session whose goal is parked behind long-running background work now checks in automatically after 30 minutes (then 1h, 2h) instead of waiting for you to return

features.description: SIGTERM in print/SDK mode stops recording interrupted turns and synthetic tool denials; still exits 143.
features.reference_changelog_line: SIGTERM in print/SDK mode no longer records an interrupted turn or synthetic tool denials before exiting; running commands are still terminated and the process still exits with code 143

features.description: A mistyped or unavailable slash command is reported instead of fuzzy-matched; prefixes and aliases still run.
features.reference_changelog_line: Pressing Enter on a slash-command typo or a command unavailable in this session now reports it instead of running the closest fuzzy match; prefixes and aliases still run

features.description: SendMessage now rejects bursts up front once a target session's inbox capacity would be exceeded.
features.reference_changelog_line: `SendMessage` now refuses further messages to a session up front once a rapid burst would exceed what that session's inbox accepts, instead of reporting them sent while they were dropped

features.description: macOS sandbox wildcard read-deny rules now outrank allowed read regions, cover directories, and survive renames.
features.reference_changelog_line: Sandbox: on macOS, wildcard read-deny rules (e.g. `**/.env`) now take precedence inside allowed read regions, cover matched directories' contents, and can't be bypassed by renaming the denied file

features.description: ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL sets the starting model for new sessions while a /model pick still overrides it.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_MODEL` environment variable: sets the model new sessions start on, while a `/model` pick still overrides it and persists across restarts (unlike `ANTHROPIC_MODEL`)

features.description: SendMessage gains notify_when_idle for a one-shot notice when a target local session next goes idle.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `notify_when_idle` to cross-session `SendMessage`: ask another Claude Code session on this machine to send one notice when it next goes idle — opt-in, one-shot, no polling (macOS and Linux)

features.description: Built-in "Concise" output style that leads with results and skips preamble, selectable in /config.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added a built-in "Concise" output style: Claude leads with results and skips preamble and narration, while doing the work just as thoroughly. Select it under Output style in /config.

features.description: Bash execution restored under claude-code-action's allowed_non_write_users permission gate on GitHub runners
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed every Bash command failing under `claude-code-action` with `allowed_non_write_users` on GitHub-hosted runners

features.description: Sandbox network domain lists require bracketed IPv6 literals; ambiguous spellings now fail closed.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved sandbox: IPv6 literals in network domain lists are now bracketed (`[::1]:443`), and ambiguous spellings are enforced fail-closed and flagged by `/doctor`

features.description: /commit-push-pr no longer auto-approves git/gh commands carrying dangerous flags such as --force or --no-verify.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `/commit-push-pr` so git/gh commands with dangerous flags (`--force`, `--amend`, `--no-verify`, etc.) are no longer auto-approved

features.description: New `claude remote-control --continue` flag resumes the most recent Remote Control session.
features.reference_changelog_line: Documented `claude remote-control --continue` for resuming the most recent Remote Control session

features.description: Self-hosted runner sessions can receive server-supplied Claude Code hooks like managed environments.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added server-supplied Claude Code hook support for self-hosted runner sessions, matching managed-environment behavior

features.description: Plugin marketplaces accept `command` sources re-resolved each session, with `mode: "link"` for in-place use.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added plugin marketplace `command` sources: a local command (e.g. an IDE) prints the plugin directory, which is re-resolved each session and applied without a restart; `mode: "link"` uses it in place

features.description: ListAgents now labels disconnected Remote Control sessions `offline` and your own sessions `cloud`.
features.reference_changelog_line: `ListAgents` now marks disconnected Remote Control sessions as `offline` and labels your cloud sessions as `cloud`

features.description: CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS controls staggering of same-prefix sibling agents for prefix cache reuse.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved workflow fan-outs to stagger same-prefix sibling agents so subsequent agents read the cached prompt prefix instead of re-paying it (`CLAUDE_CODE_WORKFLOW_PREFIX_STAGGER_MS=0` disables)

features.description: Warns when a restricted subagent model is requested and the parent model runs instead.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added a warning when workflow agents, forked skills, slash commands, or resumed background agents' requested subagent model is restricted and the parent model runs instead

features.description: Crafted Bash commands can no longer hide parts of themselves from permission checks.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a Bash permission bypass where a crafted command could hide parts of itself from permission checks

features.description: Tab or invisible-Unicode padding can no longer hide command text from the approval dialog.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed permission prompts so commands padded with tabs or invisible Unicode can no longer hide part of the command from the approval dialog

features.description: Workflow scripts can no longer use dynamic import() to escape the workflow sandbox.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed workflow scripts being able to use dynamic `import()` to run code outside the workflow sandbox

features.description: Agent-definition bypassPermissions now respects the org bypass-permissions disable policy.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a permission gap where an agent definition's `bypassPermissions` mode ignored the org bypass-permissions disable policy

features.description: Server-delivered settings no longer disable local managed-settings/MDM env; admin env merges per key.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed managed settings: server-delivered settings no longer disable the env block of a machine-local `managed-settings.json` or MDM profile; admin env now merges per key

features.description: CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT now holds every native-1M Claude model to 200K, with a startup warning.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` to hold every Claude model with a native 1M window to 200K via auto-compaction, not just a fixed list; a startup warning now appears when auto-compaction isn't holding the session to 200K

features.description: Auto-compact now caps unrecognized model IDs at the assumed window; opt out via a new env var.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed auto-compact to keep sessions on unrecognized model IDs within the assumed context window instead of letting them grow past it; set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_UNKNOWN_MODEL_WINDOW_ENFORCEMENT=1` to restore the previous behavior

features.description: /review is now an alias of /code-review, which takes a level and optional PR number.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `/review` to be an alias of `/code-review`, which reviews the current diff or a PR (`/code-review <level> <pr#>`); use `/code-review ultra` for a deep cloud review

features.description: /code-review with no effort level now reuses the level typed last instead of a fixed default.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `/code-review` with no effort level to reuse the level you typed last; type a level like `/code-review high` to change it

features.description: Cloud sessions can be continued locally with claude --teleport <session id>.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added a `/teleport` hint in cloud sessions showing how to continue locally with `claude --teleport <session id>`

features.description: Marketplace allow/block managed settings accept owner/* wildcards for a whole GitHub org.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added owner wildcard entries (`"owner/*"`) to the `strictKnownMarketplaces` and `blockedMarketplaces` managed settings for allowing or blocking all marketplace repos under a GitHub org

features.description: Long project paths no longer resolve into another project's session directory across resume/rename/delete.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed long (>200 char) project paths resolving to another project's session directory under a shared sanitized prefix; session list, rename, fork, delete and `/resume` no longer cross projects

features.description: Sandbox filesystem deny entries with a trailing slash were silently bypassable on Linux and macOS.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed sandbox filesystem deny entries written with a trailing slash (e.g. `denyRead: "~/.aws/"`) being silently bypassable on Linux and macOS

features.description: The 200-subagent-per-session spawn cap is gone; concurrency and depth limits still apply.
features.reference_changelog_line: Removed the 200-subagent-per-session spawn cap; long-running sessions no longer refuse new agents (concurrency and depth limits still apply)

features.description: Managed-settings approval prompt no longer reappears after re-login or org switch when settings are unchanged.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed managed settings: the approval prompt no longer re-appears after re-login or org switching when the organization's settings are unchanged

features.description: Feedback-survey transcript share now also uploads the system prompt (CLAUDE.md), tool definitions, and model params.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed the feedback-survey transcript share: with your consent it now also uploads the last request's model settings — the system prompt (which includes your `CLAUDE.md` instructions), tool definitions, and model parameters. Secrets are redacted as before, and these fields are dropped first if the share is too large

features.description: Bash tool description now always states that command output is shown to the model, not reliably to the user.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed the Bash tool description to always note that command output is displayed to the model, not reliably to the user

features.description: New `claude self-hosted-runner` command hosts web, mobile, and desktop sessions on your own machines.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added self-hosted environments: `claude self-hosted-runner` turns your own machines or containers into a place Claude Code web, mobile, and desktop sessions can run, on Team and Enterprise plans

features.description: Cross-session `SendMessage` plus `ListAgents` let sessions message each other across machines on macOS and Linux.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added cross-session `SendMessage`: Claude Code sessions can now message each other, on any of your machines, with `ListAgents` to discover them (macOS and Linux)

features.description: Sandbox credential masking adds extract, JWT claim masking, and AWS SigV4 re-signing, gated on tlsTerminate.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added sandbox credential-masking options: `extract` and `onExtractNoMatch` for structured env values, `decode: "jwt"` with `maskClaims` for JWT-aware masking, and `awsPairs`/`sigv4` for AWS SigV4 re-signing; these need `network.tlsTerminate` and are honored only from user, managed, or `--settings` settings

features.description: New `archive` plugin source installs plugins from an HTTPS zip with optional SHA-256 pinning.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `archive` plugin source: install plugins from a zip over HTTPS without git or npm, with optional SHA-256 pinning

features.description: `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX` picks a cross-region inference profile instead of the AWS_REGION-derived one.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `ANTHROPIC_BEDROCK_REGION_PREFIX` env var for Bedrock to prefer a specific cross-region inference profile over the `AWS_REGION`-derived one

features.description: New `crossSessionInbound` and `dialogExpiry` settings gate messages sent into bypassed-permission sessions.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `crossSessionInbound` and `dialogExpiry` settings: cross-session messages sent to a session running with bypassed permissions are held for your approval, and messages to other sessions auto-deliver

features.description: A transient 401 no longer overwrites CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN with a short-lived login token in headless runs.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a transient 401 replacing a long-lived `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN` with a stored login's short-lived token, breaking headless sessions until restart

features.description: MCP OAuth servers on macOS no longer emit 401 bursts as if unauthenticated after a keychain read timeout.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed MCP OAuth servers on macOS intermittently failing with a burst of 401 errors, as if never authenticated, after a keychain read timed out

features.description: Auto mode no longer counts a safety-filter refusal of its own permission check toward the consecutive-block limit.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed auto mode counting a safety-filter refusal of its own permission check toward the consecutive-block limit; the action is still denied, but the model is now told to move on rather than retry

features.description: A confirmed Remote Control SendMessage recipient is never swapped for a same-named session on this machine.
features.reference_changelog_line: SendMessage: a Remote Control recipient you already confirmed is never swapped for a same-named session on this machine when its own list couldn't be checked

features.description: `claude agents` now shows a workspace trust prompt for untrusted directories, matching `claude`.
features.reference_changelog_line: Added a workspace trust prompt to `claude agents` for untrusted directories, matching the behavior of `claude`

features.description: SendMessage can open a conversation with a named Remote Control session, listed by ListAgents as `name [ref]`.
features.reference_changelog_line: SendMessage can now start a conversation with your Remote Control sessions on other machines by name (`ListAgents` shows them as `name [ref]`), instead of only replying after they message you first

features.description: claude plugin validate now warns when a marketplace or plugin name would be rejected by Desktop sync
features.reference_changelog_line: Added warnings to `claude plugin validate` when a marketplace or plugin name would be rejected by Claude Desktop's managed marketplace sync

features.description: Bash permission-check bypass via zsh [[ ]] regex conditionals closed; such commands now prompt
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed a Bash tool permission-check bypass where zsh could execute hidden commands in `[[ ]]` regex conditionals; affected commands now prompt for permission

features.description: Auto-mode permission checks are cache-efficient for parallel tool calls and re-prompt on mode switch
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved auto mode: permission checks for parallel tool calls are now cache-efficient, and switching modes while a check is pending reliably prompts instead of applying the stale result

features.description: Background sessions now commit, push, follow CLAUDE.md git rules, and report where the work lives
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed background sessions to commit and push to preserve work, open a draft PR only when the task calls for one, follow your CLAUDE.md git instructions, and always end by reporting where the work lives

features.description: /plugin install refreshes a stale marketplace catalog and retries before reporting a plugin not found
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `/plugin install` to refresh a stale marketplace catalog and retry before reporting a plugin not found

features.description: Plugins installed via /plugin activate immediately when safe instead of requiring /reload-plugins
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed plugins installed from `/plugin` to activate immediately when safe, instead of always requiring `/reload-plugins`

features.description: Sessions forked with /fork now create their own worktree instead of sharing the original checkout
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed sessions forked with `/fork` to create a new worktree of their own instead of working in the original session's checkout

features.description: New prompt-audit subcommand in the claude-api skill audits prompts and tool descriptions for stale patterns
features.reference_changelog_line: Added a `prompt-audit` subcommand to the `claude-api` skill for auditing prompts and tool descriptions for patterns written for older models

features.description: Sandbox credential files support mode: "mask" on Linux/WSL with proxy substitution; macOS falls back to deny
features.reference_changelog_line: Added `mode: "mask"` for sandbox credential files on Linux and WSL — sandboxed commands read a sentinel copy (the whole file, or just the spans captured by an `extract` regex) while the sandbox proxy substitutes the real value on egress; on macOS file masking falls back to `deny`

features.description: Plugins may set "." as a skills path, and root SKILL.md validation errors now suggest the plugin root
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed plugins to accept `"."` as a `skills` path, and the root-level `SKILL.md` validation error now suggests using the plugin root

features.description: /status reports session kind: interactive, or a background job that is attached or unattended
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed `/status` to show the session kind: `interactive`, or a background job that is `attached` or `unattended`

features.description: Worktree isolation now covers file edits and Bash in every session type, blocking destructive git against main.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed worktree-isolated sessions and their subagents being able to run destructive git commands against the main checkout; isolation now applies to file edits and Bash in every session type

features.description: PreToolUse auto-allow hooks no longer bypass tool restrictions in background agent tasks.
features.reference_changelog_line: Fixed PreToolUse auto-allow hooks bypassing tool restrictions in background agent tasks (summaries, compaction, renames)

features.description: Auto mode now runs SendMessage payloads to other agent sessions through the permission classifier before dispatch.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved auto mode safety: messages sent to other agent sessions via `SendMessage` are now evaluated by the permission classifier before dispatch

features.description: Skills with disable-model-invocation now make Claude ask the user to run them instead of replicating the workflow.
features.reference_changelog_line: Improved the refusal when Claude tries to invoke a skill with `disable-model-invocation`: Claude is now told to ask you to run the skill instead of replicating its workflow

features.description: Repo-local settings.json can no longer enable Remote Control auto-start; only disable it or enable at user scope.
features.reference_changelog_line: Changed Remote Control auto-start so repo-local settings (`.claude/settings.json` or `.claude/settings.local.json`) can no longer turn it on (they can still turn it off); enable it at user scope via `/config`

features.description: The ultraplan feature was removed from Claude Code.
features.reference_changelog_line: Removed ultraplan feature
